polls.q: Regular Football GM: how should the 1996 Browns move work?
polls.note: The mod already does the real move. This is only for leagues in regular Football GM.

options.label: Keep history right
options.desc: Browns history stays in Cleveland; their players go to free agency (now)

options.label: Keep the roster together
options.desc: The Browns become the Ravens, players and all, but their 1966-95 history goes with them

polls.note: Pick one. The most-wanted ideas go to the top of the roadmap.
